text:
how to keep your head about you

1. never go against your gut instinct

this can only be fully understood through error, pain and suffering

all self-inflicted catastrophes in ur life, will begin with u going against your gut

trusting the judgment of the crowd over your instinct

God punishes you first for blindly following the crowd, and second, the far deeper pain, is the pain of self-betrayal

it will haunt u not just that u ignored ur instinct, but that u can still remember the exact moment u did

u may call it ur intuition, ur conscience, your soul, your spirit...Jung believed that the subconscious is the voice of God speaking to you, and I'll subscribe to that.

but the way you keep your head about you, is to never go against your gut instinct...it will keep u calm amid chaos, poised under pressure, and is the best guide u have as u are walking through the storm.
